scope: Documents say headings, and Options say what kind of control each setting is.

topics.title: Headings in documents
details: When you move onto a heading, you hear its level first, such as Heading level 1.
This works with the arrows, and when you say Next paragraph, Next heading, or Read paragraph.
When you make a heading, you hear its level.
Bold, fonts, and other text settings are not said as you move. Press Insert+F, or say Read formatting, to hear them.

topics.title: Options say each kind of control
details: Each setting says what it is: check box, combo box, edit, or button.
A check box says checked or not checked.
A combo box says its choice and where it is in the list, such as 2 of 3.

topics.title: Documents
details: Press Enter at the end of a heading, and the next line is normal text, as in Word.
Delete line no longer says two periods.

topics.title: Switching email accounts
details: You hear Switched to and the account at once. Then the inbox loads.
